title: Emi rounds 1 and 2: a 3D chibi made the way Kuro round 3 was
question: Round 2 (emi-2, last option) has no lanyard and her jaw edges repainted, and is in the game; is she right now?

options.label: emi-1
options.note: The rigged model from c1 (chat a2, b1, c1): smart topology, 1,050 polygons, our UV layout with the face in one piece, Meshy retexture styled from c1, auto-rig at 1.1 m. Head share of height 0.48, head width 2.78 times the legs (Kuro round 3: 0.41 and 2.20). Grey-blue dashes under both cheeks. 20 Meshy credits; the six ChatGPT pictures cost $1.48.

options.label: emi-2 (round 2)
options.note: Round 2, from picture c3 (chat a2, b1, then "Simpler head model, no glasses, no lanyard"): smart topology, 1,050 polygons, our UV layout with the face in one piece, Meshy retexture styled from c3, auto-rig at 1.1 m, Meshy sit. No lanyard; head share 0.43 (round 1 0.48). In the game the dark texels along her jaw are repainted in skin. 23 Meshy credits; three pictures $0.74. In the game since this round.
